description: This PHP source file implements an interface for integrating TestLink with Jira via REST API, including configuration setup, establishing connection, and creating issues through Jira's REST API.

classes.name: jirarestInterface
classes.description: A class providing methods to interact with Jira's REST API for issue management in the context of TestLink integration.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new Jira issue with the specified summary and description via the API client.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the connection to Jira API is successfully established.
